title: Scholarships for International Students
about: Scholarships for new international students at Yeungnam University Graduate School, graded by language test scores and awarded on department recommendation. The second application round for Spring 2027 entry runs online from 16 November to 11 December 2026 (17:00); documents are due 18 December.
requirements: New international graduate students recommended by their department
Award tier based on TOPIK, IELTS, TOEFL iBT or TOEIC scores
Top-tier recipients assist with teaching or lab work up to 10 hours per week
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Scholarships for International Students at the Graduate School of Yeungnam University, South Korea, deadline 11 December 2026. The photo shows a royal guard ceremony at Gwanghwamun Gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace in Seoul, not the university's city.
